The case of the petitioners is that thier land in Survey No.94, measuring 3 Acres 07 Guntas of Doddagollahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk, Bangalore Rural District, was acquired for the purpose of respondent No.2- Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (KIADB).
However, respondent No.3 has passed a general award and deposited the compensation in the Reference Court.
They pray that consent award be passed in respect of the said land.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that they have no objection to pass a consent award provided the petitioners produces all the relevant documents to show that they are Smt Sanjeevamma vs The State Of Karnataka on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195849920/
2 the owners of the property.
